done_when: Client sign-off passes on a green full run, matching answers, a strict review with no serious findings and a clean completeness review, and when something is missing one refusal lists every gap.

findings.body:
Gain 3, Work 2, Harm 1
Raise: Test. Case: normal use - running the sign-off reuse tests after this change. The new cache key reruns completeness review when app.py or the brief's answers change. However, tests/test_signoff_reuse.py:114 still requires exactly one Claude call for both the `product` and `answers` cases; each now produces two calls, so both assertions fail. Update those cases to verify the intended completeness invalidation alongside the strict review, preserving reuse assertions for unchanged inputs.
findings.title: Gate: test_5_signoff_reuses_results_until_their_inputs_change

why: After the upgrade to v1.2.22, client sign-off loops because the ritual checks added in v1.2.21 stop it one missing record at a time.
